verdicts.reason: A keeps the scooter rider inside its white circle and the headline reads well on the left. But the tiny 'Betty Williams' credit floats on its own in the middle of the banner, away from the quote, and the empty bands on either side of it look like dead space. B breaks the illustration: the white circle sits empty at the far left while the rider is stranded on bare red at the right, so the brand graphic is broken apart. B's headline is also shrunk and crowded into a small cluster in the left-centre, with the credit at an unreadable size.
